column1: # Files scripts/setup.sh installs into the home directory.
#   link  repo file is symlinked; edits in either place are the same file,
#         so `setup pull` needs nothing more than git pull (own config)
#   copy  repo file is copied; `setup pull` / `setup sync` refresh the copy,
#         and ask first if the copy was edited locally (backup kept)
#   git   upstream repository cloned once; `setup pull` fast-forwards it
